findings.bug: Phase 8 nests `--out DIR --shot ID` via filepath.Join(outParent, shot) with no shot-id allowlist; project_v1.json and LoadAndResolveShot accept any nonempty shot id. Absolute ids discard DIR; `../` ids escape the intended nest.
findings.predicted: A malicious or agent-authored project can redirect job dirs (and Blender writes under them) outside the caller’s `--out` tree while still passing resolve/validate.
findings.fix_hint: Constrain shot ids to `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` in schema+loader and reject Join results that leave the resolved `--out` root.

findings.bug: Plan required refusing nonempty destinations unless explicit overwrite; compile.WriteToDir unconditionally overwrites apply_scene.py, scene_data.json, source_map.json, and dependencies.json in the caller-supplied `--out` directory.
findings.predicted: Agents or scripts pointed at a shared/existing directory clobber non-job files that share those names (confused-deputy write).
findings.fix_hint: Require empty `--out` or an explicit `--overwrite` limited to MoBlend-owned artifact names before WriteToDir.

findings.bug: ARCHITECTURE asked for explicit job environment; Run leaves Options.Env nil so Blender inherits the full parent environ (secrets, tokens, proxy creds).
findings.predicted: Any Blender/Python side effect or crash dump can observe ambient credentials the orchestrator never intended to expose into the render child.
findings.fix_hint: Pass a minimal allowlisted env (PATH, MOBLEND_*, display/locale as needed) instead of inheriting by default.

findings.bug: Containment EvalSymlinks then returns the pre-symlink abs path; later load/hash (readBounded, BuildDependencyManifest) re-open that path and follow whatever the symlink is at read time. rootReal also silently falls back to unevaluated root if EvalSymlinks(root) fails.
findings.predicted: A racing replace of an in-root path with an escaping symlink between check and read can load or hash out-of-root bytes despite PROJ_PATH_ESCAPE tests for static escapes.
findings.fix_hint: Open with O_NOFOLLOW (or re-EvalSymlinks+containment immediately before read) and fail closed if root cannot be realpath’d.

findings.bug: Inspect calls resolveContainedPath(root, root, …) without EvalSymlinks(root), unlike resolveManifest; containment failures are swallowed and the module is still listed.
findings.predicted: Inspect and resolve disagree on symlink-root projects; escape attempts are soft-ignored in inspect instead of hard-failing with PROJ_PATH_ESCAPE.
findings.fix_hint: Reuse the same rootReal computation as resolve and surface containment errors instead of omitting fields.
